system.description:
Light armor was typically worn by security personnel, those for whom combat is a risk, but not guaranteed, and by those unwilling to sacrifice mobility for protection. Light armor is commonly covered in pouches, belts, and other fixtures for carrying tools and other equipment.

Tech Level 2 Light Armor is Armor which provides Protection of 2. Tech Level 3 Light Armor provides Protection 3 instead. In either case, this Protection is reduced to half (rounding up) by attacks with the breaker keyword. Light Armor is handy.
